viral.maxLenHelp: YouTube Shorts can be up to 3 minutes.
viral.pressSpace: The playhead is at the clip start. Press Space in Premiere to play it.
viral.promptPh: Example: the moment I was surprised by the sales results, or tips you can try in 1 minute
viral.resSub: Done in {time}. Your original sequence is untouched
viral.ruleWhy: Scores come from keywords, voice volume and speech density. Check each clip before you use it.
viral.stageMarkers: Add markers to the original sequence
viral.styleCustomHint: Describe the kind of moment you are looking for.
viral.styleDefaultHint: Moments that make people stop scrolling: a strong opening and a clear payoff.
viral.styleEduHint: Tips or steps viewers can use right away.
viral.styleFunnyHint: Spontaneous moments, slips, reactions. Voice energy counts for more.
viral.styleSalesHint: Benefits, prices, promos, results. Makes viewers want to buy or sign up.
viral.styleStoryHint: A problem, some tension, then a resolution or a lesson.
viral.subseqFail: Could not make the clip sequences.
viral.subseqFailHint: Try turning off "A sequence for each clip" to get markers only.
viral.subseqHelp: Named "Viral 01 - Title" in the {bin} bin, with every track and effect. Your original sequence is untouched.
viral.title: Viral Clips
viral.topicHelp: Clips about this topic come first and get a "topic" tag.
viral.ungrounded: The numbers {nums} are never said in the clip. Check the title and hook.
viral.useAiHelp: Off: clips are found from keywords, voice volume and speech density (no AI).
viral.verticalHelp: Each clip also gets a vertical version through Auto Resize.
viral.verticalNote: Uses Premiere Auto Reframe. For screen recordings, Auto Resize > Smart gives the best result.
voice.applyNote: The engine renders the new voice, then Premiere is busy for a moment. Your original sequence is untouched.
voice.breathsHelp: Breaths in pauses get quieter, not removed.
voice.busy: Still running. Wait or cancel it first.
voice.clicksHelp: Clicks between words are turned down. Words aren't touched.
voice.deleted: Result deleted. The original sequence is open again.
voice.denHelp: AI is the cleanest, runs on the CPU
voice.desc: Remove noise and clicks, even out your voice volume
voice.duckHelp: Music on other tracks gets quieter while you speak.

voice.duckTxt.one: Music on {tracks} drops {db} dB in {n} speech part.
voice.duckTxt.other: Music on {tracks} drops {db} dB in {n} speech parts.

voice.eqOnHelp: Your voice tone is shaped like the sample, at most 6 dB in each band.
voice.eqReady: EQ from "{name}" is ready to use.
voice.eqRefHelp: Choose a voice recording you like.
voice.errLocked: Couldn't disable the old voice: track {tracks} is locked.
voice.errLockedHint: Unlock that track in Premiere, then click Try again.
voice.errNoAudio: The old voice clips weren't found in the new sequence.
voice.errNoAudioHint: The sequence may have changed after the analysis. Analyze again, then process.
voice.failCleaned: {why} The temporary sequence "{name}" was deleted, your project is back as it was.
voice.hpHelp: 0 = off. 80 Hz removes AC and desk rumble
voice.lead: Your voice is cleaned of noise, mouse clicks, and breaths, then its loudness is evened out for your platform. The result goes into a new sequence, your original is untouched.
voice.listenHelp: 10 s from the playhead (or the busiest speech part), with the current settings.
voice.loudnessHelp: Peaks are limited to -1 dBTP so they don't clip
voice.nextCaptions: Make captions from the clear voice
voice.nextSilence: Your voice is clean, now cut the pauses
voice.noDialog: The file dialog isn't available here.
voice.noOtherTracks: No other tracks. If you add music later, run this again.
voice.noPlan: The engine returned no voice plan.
voice.noReview: The engine returned no review file.
voice.openSeqForMusic: Open a sequence to see the music tracks.
voice.preset.kuatHint: Noise fully removed, a firm voice that's clear on phones. For noisy rooms.
voice.preset.naturalHint: Clean but still sounds like you. Good for tutorials.
voice.preset.podcastHint: Warmer and fuller, even volume. Easy to listen to for a long time.
voice.profHelp: Save these settings as a profile. The last profile is used again automatically.
voice.profNamePh: Profile name, for example Studio Voice
voice.resLine1: Sequence "{name}": original voice disabled, new voice on track {track}.
voice.resLine2: {clicks} clicks and {breaths} breaths turned down, noise {den}, peak {tp0} to {tp1} dBTP.
voice.resSub: Your voice was cleaned and evened out in {dur}. Your original sequence is untouched.
voice.rvTitleSub: of {all} clicks and breaths, current loudness {lufs} LUFS
voice.title: Clear Voice
voice.twins: Tracks {tracks} hold the same voice, all of them were disabled.
voice.wDuckLocked: Music on locked tracks wasn't lowered: {tracks}.
voice.wDynamic: Loudness was evened out in dynamic mode, not with one fixed gain.

voice.wMissing.one: {n} old voice clip wasn't found in the new sequence. Check whether the voice is doubled.
voice.wMissing.other: {n} old voice clips weren't found in the new sequence. Check whether the voice is doubled.

voice.wMuted.one: {n} old voice clip was muted with volume (it couldn't be disabled).
voice.wMuted.other: {n} old voice clips were muted with volume (they couldn't be disabled).

voice.wTrackName: Couldn't name the track "{track}". The new voice is on the bottom audio track ({idx}).
zoom.aiHelp: One AI request to pick the key moments. Without AI it still works using rules.
zoom.desc: Smooth zooms to the cursor or key moments.
zoom.empty.rhythm: Too few sentences to alternate. Try Speech emphasis mode.
zoom.empty.screen: No clear screen action found (clicks, typing, menus). Try turning off some ignore zones, raising Max zooms a minute, or using Speech emphasis mode.
zoom.empty.speech: No key words or standout sounds found. Try raising Max zooms a minute or using Rhythmic mode.
zoom.errBadPlan: Unknown zoom plan from the engine.
zoom.errCancelled: Cancelled. Sequence "{name}" only got some of the zooms.
zoom.errCancelledHint: Delete that sequence and run it again.
zoom.errPlanRead: Couldn't read the zoom plan file.
zoom.freqHelp: Lower = calmer. The spacing between zooms is set automatically.
zoom.lead: Smooth zooms to whatever you're talking about. In screen recordings, the zoom follows the cursor and clicks.
zoom.mode.rhythmDesc: Alternates wide and close every sentence, like shooting with two cameras.
zoom.mode.screenDesc: Zooms into the part of the screen being clicked, typed in, or pointed at. For tutorials and screen recordings.
zoom.mode.speechDesc: Punches in on key words, numbers, or louder moments. If there is a face, it zooms to the face.
zoom.nextCaptions: Add captions to the zoomed sequence
zoom.pvImgErr: The preview image can't be shown.
zoom.pvNoImg: No image for this moment yet.
zoom.pvOutCut: Exits instantly when the screen changes
zoom.pvRenderTip: Render this part as a short video with the zoom
zoom.pvVideoErr: The video can't play in the panel. Click Open in player.
zoom.rampHint.fast: Moves in fast, then stops softly. Feels punchier.
zoom.rampHint.jump: No animation, jumps straight in like a camera cut.
zoom.rampHint.smooth: Eases in and out gently. Best for tutorials.
zoom.rampSHelp: How long zooming in takes. Zooming out takes a little longer.
zoom.rangeTwo: Zoom {a} to {b}, the smaller the action area, the closer it gets.

zoom.resSub.one: {n} zoom on {clips} clip(s){time}. Your original sequence is untouched.
zoom.resSub.other: {n} zooms on {clips} clip(s){time}. Your original sequence is untouched.

zoom.title: Auto Zoom
zoom.trackHelp: Overlays on upper tracks (captions, B-roll) are not zoomed.
zoom.trackNote: Premiere is busy for a moment while the keyframes are added. Your original sequence is untouched.
zoom.warnKeys: Those clips already have their own Motion keyframes (not from Auto Zoom), so they were left alone.
zoom.warnMissing: The sequence changed after the analysis. Analyze again so every zoom gets applied.
zoom.warnUniform: Uniform Scale is off on those clips. Turn it on and apply again.
zoom.zmaxHelp: The closest it gets. Screen text at 2292 px stays sharp up to about 2.2x.
zoom.zone.browserTip: Tabs and the address bar at the top
zoom.zone.edgesTip: Scrollbars and the left and right edges
zoom.zone.notifTip: Bottom right corner, where Windows notifications pop up
zoom.zone.taskbarTip: The bottom row of the screen (icons, clock)
zoom.zonesHelp: Movement in these areas never triggers a zoom. The clock, notifications, and taskbar icons often pull the zoom off target.
